lines.t: In the silence of your longing heart,
You searched the world and fell apart.
But I have watched, I have known your cry,
Beloved, lift your eyes to the sky.
Only One who can fulfill your heart’s innermost desire,
I am He, beloved—eternal fire.
No other love can ever satisfy,
I am He, beloved—YahuShua, Most High.
Come out from among them, turn away,
Let the shadows fade into day.
Be joined unto Me, your soul restored,
For I am the promise, forever adored.
Only One who can fulfill your heart’s innermost desire,
I am He, beloved—eternal fire.
No other love can ever satisfy,
I am He, beloved—YahuShua, Most High.
Let peace like rivers flow within,
For My mercy covers every sin.
Beloved child, you’re precious to Me,
I AM HE who sets you free.
Only One who can fulfill your heart’s innermost desire,
I am He, beloved—eternal fire.
Find your rest and come ever nigh,
For I am He, your dwelling, Most High.
